The location where the resources will be created. This should be the same region as the hub.
Optional. The tags to be assigned to the created resources.
Required. Whether to enable deplotment telemetry.
The resource ID of the existing hub virtual network.
The resource id of the bastion host.
CIDR of the spoke virtual network. For most landing zone implementations, the spoke network would have been created by your platform team.
Optional. The name of the subnet to create for the spoke infrastructure. If set, it overrides the name generated by the template.
CIDR of the spoke infrastructure subnet.
Optional. The name of the subnet to create for the spoke private endpoints. If set, it overrides the name generated by the template.
CIDR of the spoke private endpoints subnet.
Optional. The name of the subnet to create for the spoke application gateway. If set, it overrides the name generated by the template.
CIDR of the spoke Application Gateway subnet. If the value is empty, this subnet will not be created.
Optional. The name of the subnet to create for the deployment sctripts. If set, it overrides the name generated by the template.
Required. The CIDR to use for Deployment scripts subnet.
Optional. Define whether to route spoke-internal traffic within the spoke network. If false, traffic will be sent to the hub network. Default is false.
The IP address of the network appliance (e.g. firewall) that will be used to route traffic to the internet.
The size of the jump box virtual machine to create. See https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/virtual-machines/sizes for more information.
Optional. The zone to create the jump box in. Defaults to 0.
Optional. The storage account type to use for the jump box. Defaults to Standard_LRS.
The password to use for the jump box.
The SSH public key to use for the jump box. Only relevant for Linux.
The OS of the jump box virtual machine to create. If set to "none", no jump box will be created.
Optional. The name of the subnet to create for the jump box. If set, it overrides the name generated by the template.
CIDR to use for the jump box subnet.
Type of authentication to use on the Virtual Machine. SSH key is recommended.

The name of the spoke virtual network.

The name of the spoke deployment subnet.
The resource ID of the spoke deployment subnet.
The resource ID of the spoke Application Gateway subnet. This is '' if the subnet was not created.
The name of the spoke Application Gateway subnet.  This is '' if the subnet was not created.
The resource ID of the Azure Log Analytics Workspace.
